title: Voice agents and realtime audio
subtitle: Build conversational audio with turn control, interruption, and safe actions.
goal: Follow speech from microphone to an authorized response
intro: Voice adds uncertain recognition, turn timing, playback state, and privacy to the ordinary agent lifecycle.
case: A customer corrects a number while the assistant is speaking.
The agent uses the final intended number and discards obsolete audio.
A partial transcript can reverse intent when the user adds a negation.
